name: Arioch
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

points: Then Daniel answered with counsel and wisdom to Arioch the captain of the king's guard, which was gone forth to slay the wise men of Babylon: he answered and said to Arioch the king's captain, Why is the decree so hasty from the king? Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel. So Daniel was like, slow down. What are you going to kill everybody for? Let me go talk to God. Why are you so hasty to kill everybody?
